steps.message: Found it — a repo-specific jj config overrides `immutable_heads()` to `bookmarks()`, so *every* bookmark (including your local `retry-backoff` feature bookmark) locks its entire ancestry, not just `main`. That's why `19cfeaa7` is stuck. There's no remote configured, so `trunk()` won't resolve — I'll point `immutable_heads()` at `main` directly, which matches "keep main protected" literally.

steps.message: Done. The repo config at `/root/.config/jj/repos/c74de1f2d5e93c085f05/config.toml` had `immutable_heads() = "bookmarks()"`, which locked the whole stack because the `retry-backoff` bookmark sat on top of it — I narrowed that to `"main"` so only `main` (and its ancestors) stay immutable. Then rewrote `19cfeaa7` to "handle nonces on retried charges", which rebased the two descendant commits automatically; `retry-backoff` and your working copy now sit cleanly on top.
